feeds.title: Sydney Morning Herald
feeds.description: Sydney Morning Herald provides breaking news from Sydney, Australia, and features the latest business, sport, entertainment, travel, lifestyle, and technology news.

feeds.title: Sydney Chic
feeds.description: Explore the hidden gems of Sydney's bustling streets, from trendy cafes and high-end boutiques to cultural events that ignite the city's spirit. Sydney Chic blog is your key to unlocking the essence of Sydney's cosmopolitan lifestyle, where the old-world charm meets modern elegance.

feeds.title: Sydney - City and Suburbs
feeds.description: Sydney City and Suburbs is a travel blog where you will find various tourists places to visit during your stay in sydney.

feeds.title: Mademoiselle
feeds.description: Mademoiselle is a blog by Jamie Lee Burns and in this blog she shares her personal style, beauty and travel experiences. This site is all about minimalist aesthetic with a focus on wardrobe essentials and effortless style.

feeds.title: Sydney Criminal Lawyers Blog
feeds.description: Sydney Criminal Lawyers is a highly-respected team of experienced criminal lawyers with offices in Sydney City and Parramatta. Our dedicated team is passionate about achieving outstanding outcomes for our clients and our unmatched track record of success has led to numerous awards. Follow this blog to know the latest in Criminal & Traffic Law

feeds.title: Travel & Lifestyle
feeds.description: Travel & Lifestyle is a blog by Rafael Ruiz that focuses on the latest travel, hotel, restaurant, bar, lifestyle, and events in Sydney. This blog is your portal to experiencing all that Sydney has to offer, from the latest travel trends to hidden culinary gems, pulsating nightlife serene escapes, and cultural events that ignite your soul.

feeds.title: Sydney Couple and Family
feeds.description: Sydney Couple & Family is a blog that offers marriage counselling and couples counselling services, as well as family counselling to improve all your relationships. Follow this blog for relationship, family advice and much more.

feeds.title: Escape Rooms in Sydney Blog
feeds.description: Escape Rooms in Sydney is a blog by Scott who provides his opinion on various escape rooms that have opened up in Australia. He has been to almost all escape room outfits currently open in Sydney. Follow this blog for more updates on escape room in Sydney.

feeds.title: Weekend Food Escapes Blog
feeds.description: Weekend Food Escapes is a Sydney-based food blog documenting some of my food adventures through the senses of look, smell, and taste and the culinary delights of Sydney eateries. It is run by a team of passionate foodies based in Sydney who loves photography or writing about food experiences.

feeds.title: Sydney Health Law
feeds.description: Sydney Health Law provides information on the latest developments and events in health law, ethics, and governance, focusing both nationally and globally. Follow this site to know more about topics including the ethical dilemmas of biobanks, developments in chronic disease prevention, and the issues posed by refusal of consent to medical treatment and much more.

feeds.title: Street Fashion Sydney Blog
feeds.description: Street Fashion Sydney Blog is a street fashion blog by photographer Kent Johnson. Follow this blog for more updates on fashion, beauty, photography, travel and lifestyle tips.

feeds.title: thewhereto Blog
feeds.description: thewhereto is a food blog by Kurt and Sarah Charles who share their food experiences in Sydney. Follow this site for reviews on food from various restuarants in sydney.

feeds.title: Sydney Showboats Blog
feeds.description: Blog that give a deeper insight into Sydney Showboats, a behind-the-scenes look & a fresh perspective about this legendary vessel & its cruising history on Sydney Harbour.

feeds.title: Simon Food Favourites
feeds.description: Simon Food Favourites is a Sydney food blog that provides comprehensive and honest reviews of restaurants, cafés, bars, pubs, festivals, and products to whet your appetite. The main goal of this blog is to share information about food and get to know more about the best dishes from them all.

feeds.title: Kate Waterhouse Blog
feeds.description: Kate Waterhouse is a popular fashion and personal style blog where she reports on fashion, trends, beauty, lifestyle as well as features of candid celebrity interviews. Kate is the director and founder of Kate Waterhouse. She is also a journalist, media personality, television presenter and radio talent.

feeds.title: In/Out Blog
feeds.description: Arent & Pyke are interior designers based in Sydney and In/Out is their blog, where they share with you their interior projects, and bring to light the ideas and works of other engaging and dynamic designers, artists and creatives that inspire them.

feeds.title: Transport Sydney
feeds.description: Transport Sydney is an independent transport infrastructure news blog designed to bridge the gap between the daily news bulletins that are easy to read but often lack depth and the expert reports that are long and difficult to digest for an ordinary individual.

feeds.title: I'm Still Hungry
feeds.description: A Sydney food blog providing informative restaurant reviews, with a dose of global travel sprinkled into the mix. I'm Still Hungry is here to make sure the food you eat is never boring, and always keep the cravings going.

feeds.title: Garden Amateur
feeds.description: Living in Sydney's inner-west with his wife Pam, the author usually blogs about what's happening in their small garden and our kitchen too. The blog provides useful ideas, personal gardening experience stories, gardening tips, product reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Does My Bomb Look Big In This
feeds.description: Does My Bomb Look Big In This is a food blog established back in 2006 which provides a comprehensive look at Sydney's thriving food scene through words and pictures. It's written by Jackie McMillan. Follow this blog for interesting restaurants, events, products and food store reviews in Sydney.

feeds.title: Sir and M'lady Dine Out Blog
feeds.description: Sir and M'lady are a dynamic duo whose love of food, travel and life inspired this blog. This blog provides reviews of the best restaurants in Sydney.

feeds.title: Fashion Hound
feeds.description: Fashion Hound is a blog by Faye De Lanty who focuses on eco fashion and styling. Follow this blog for to know more about eco friendly and sustainable fashion tips.

feeds.title: Clinton Power + Associates Blog
feeds.description: Clinton Power + Associates are relationship counselors that are dedicated to improving the lives and relationships of singles, individuals in relationships, and couples. Follow the blog to stay informed with the articles and advice on dating, relationships, and sexuality.

feeds.title: CHARLIE MAE
feeds.description: Charlie Mae is an independent Australian lifestyle brand.A Charlie Mae girl is a sophisticated rebel, a lover of the outdoors who radiates beauty & strength

feeds.title: SuburbsGuide
feeds.description: Sydney Suburb Reviews is a chronicle of each suburb of Sydney, Australia with a breakdown of what each offers in terms of lifestyle, safety, streetscape & more. Each suburb receives a ranking for multiple different key criteria to assist in making the choice of where to live in Sydney for you just a little bit easier.

feeds.title: Sydney.com
feeds.description: Sydney Life is a travel blog where you will find plenty of useful tips on where to stay, what to see and things to do in Sydney. You'll also find out the best deals for accommodation, tours, restaurants and hire on offer to help you plan the perfect Sydney holiday.

feeds.title: Museums of History NSW News
feeds.description: Sydney Living Museums is a group of 12 museums, houses and gardens that will take you on a remarkable journey through time and place to experience a whole other life. Follow this blog to see sydney's living past.

feeds.title: Sydney Shop Girl
feeds.description: Sydney Shop Girl is a lifestyle and fashion blog where you can get all the updates on shopping tips and discounts and much more.

feeds.title: Sydney Dance Company
feeds.description: Sydney Dance Company is an australian contemporary dance classes. Sydney Dance Company has a broad community beyond the practice and performance of their lead dancers.

feeds.title: Sydney Jewish Museum Blog
feeds.description: The Sydney Jewish Museum gives history a voice through collecting and preserving historic objects, commemorating and educating, with a mission to challenge visitors' perceptions of morality, social justice, democracy and human rights.

feeds.title: For Food's Sake
feeds.description: For Food's Sake is a Sydney food blog sharing restaurant reviews, their favorite recipes, and some travel places in Sydney. Chronicling delicious eats, cafes, restaurants, and travel pieces worldwide! For Food's Sake is a food, travel, and lifestyle website created by family members Vanessa, Bianca, and Alex.
